_about: Dated Pune parking policy and news items shown on the City Insights page. 'status' says whether the item is in force, proposed or historical as of the source date; none of it is a live condition.

items.title: PMC Public Parking Policy
items.summary: Divides the city into Zone A (central business district), Zone B (mobility corridors) and Zone C (rest of city). Charges should rise every hour, on-street parking should cost more than off-street, no parking within 50 m of major intersections, and 1 in 20 car spaces reserved free for persons with disabilities. At the time 'most of the roads in Pune' had free on-street parking.

items.title: Pune Airport multi-level car park
items.summary: Multi-level parking in front of the airport for 1,000 cars and 1,000 two-wheelers, with app pre-booking, reported to open on 1 October 2022.

items.title: Pune Metro announces parking at 9 stations
items.summary: PCMC, Sant Tukaram Nagar, Phugewadi, Bopodi, Shivajinagar, Civil Court, Swargate, Ideal Colony and Mangalwar Peth/RTO. Two-wheelers ₹15/30/60 and cars ₹35/50/80 for up to 2 h / 2–6 h / over 6 h; 25% off with a same-day metro ticket.

items.title: PMC plans ₹5 crore for metro-station parking
items.summary: Reports that most stations lack designated parking, Swargate bus-stand parking is restricted to bus travellers, and the four Swargate–Katraj stations have no parking plans. PMC is surveying amenity spaces for parking.

items.title: Central Railway pay-and-park contracts at Pune station
items.summary: Three two- and four-wheeler sites at Pune station (Main Gate, TDRD, RR Lucky Parking) with contracts running to Sep–Dec 2025.

items.title: No metro parking in the PCMC area
items.summary: Pune Metro is reported as saying there is no parking beneath PCMC station and that parking will not be provided in the PCMC area; commuters are asked to use public transport.

items.title: On-street pay-and-park pilot: tender re-issued
items.summary: Pilot on FC Road, JM Road, Laxmi Road, Viman Nagar, Balewadi High Street and Bibvewadi. Proposed rates ₹4/h for two-wheelers and ₹20/h for cars. The earlier tender attracted too few bidders.

items.title: Airport terminal 15-minute limit
items.summary: Private vehicles may stay at most 15 minutes in the terminal area, recorded electronically; ₹500 fine beyond that.

items.title: Multi-level parking under BOT
items.summary: The non-operational Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj multi-level parking may be rebuilt; more parking explored near Mandai, Narayan Peth and Sambhaji Udyan. Awaiting Standing Committee.

items.title: Cantonment Board raises Camp parking rates by 50%
items.summary: Two-wheelers ₹8 up to 4 h / ₹15 per day, three-wheelers ₹15 / ₹23, cars ₹30 / ₹60 at MG Road, Fashion Street and other Camp lots. Overcharging complaints reported.

items.title: PMC proposes zone-based off-street rates
items.summary: Zone A: two-wheelers ₹15/h (now ₹1), cars ₹30/h (now ₹7). Zone B: two-wheelers ₹10/h (now ₹2), cars ₹20/h (now ₹10). Needs Standing Committee and General Body approval.

zone_rates_2016.unit: ₹ per hour (base rates in the 2016 policy)
